idea-plugin.name: SQL Dialect for DuckDB (embedded & Quack)
idea-plugin.description:
A real DuckDB SQL dialect for DataGrip and IntelliJ-family IDEs, with ready-to-use data sources for local/embedded DuckDB and GizmoSQL servers (Arrow-free quack-jdbc driver).

  • DuckDB syntax, measured: correct statement and run-block boundaries across the DuckDB statement surface — SELECT * EXCLUDE(...), QUALIFY, GROUP BY ALL, struct/list literals, lambdas, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, FROM-first queries, ATTACH, SUMMARIZE, CREATE MACRO/SECRET. Coverage is scored against DuckDB's own test suite: 226/226 sampled syntax families at DuckDB 1.5.5.
  • Engine-exact error checking: statements are validated by a real DuckDB (from your data source's driver; EXPLAIN-based, never executes) — squiggles carry the engine's own messages, so there is zero grammar drift.
  • Completion that follows your engine: on connect the catalog is harvested live from duckdb_functions() — your engine version, your loaded extensions. Run INSTALL/LOAD and completion updates itself; autoloaded extensions arrive via Refresh DuckDB Catalog (editor right-click). Offline you get the bundled 943-function snapshot, plus "requires <extension>" hints for extension functions.
  • Two data sources, one dialect: local file / in-memory DuckDB, and GizmoSQL over jdbc:quack:// (default port 9494). Driver versions are pinned and auto-download from Maven Central, matched to the tested engine.

GizmoSQL connection notes: paste your token into the Password field (stored in the IDE's secure storage) and leave User blank; TLS is off by default — add tls=true in the URL parameters for HTTPS endpoints.

Known issue: cancelling a running query over a GizmoSQL connection is currently a no-op in the quack driver — the query keeps running server-side. Local/embedded cancel works. A driver fix is tracked.

This is an independent, community plugin developed by Sortdev SRL, not affiliated with DuckDB Labs, the DuckDB Foundation, or GizmoSQL. "DuckDB" is a trademark of the DuckDB Foundation, used only to identify the database this plugin supports. DuckDB logo used per the DuckDB design manual.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — first public release.
  • DuckDB dialect with correct statement/run-block boundaries — coverage measured against DuckDB's own test suite (226/226 sampled syntax families at DuckDB 1.5.5).
  • Engine-exact error checking by a real DuckDB from your driver (EXPLAIN-based, never executes).
  • Live per-connection completion: functions/keywords harvested from the connected engine (version- and extension-exact), refreshed automatically when INSTALL/LOAD runs in a console, or on demand via Refresh DuckDB Catalog; bundled 943-function snapshot offline, with "requires <extension>" hints.
  • Object tree from DuckDB's JDBC metadata — ATTACHed databases appear as catalogs, on both drivers.
  • Ready-made data sources: local/embedded DuckDB and GizmoSQL (token-auth quack-jdbc, port 9494); pinned drivers auto-download from Maven Central.
  • Known issue: query cancel over GizmoSQL is a quack-driver no-op (local cancel works); driver fix tracked.
